basic_info.description: Romantic architectural heritage, dazzling panoramic views & luxurious interior design set the tone for a quintessential city life, this luxurious residence, its house-like layout & expansive public rooms are as conducive to work-at-home needs, as lavish entertaining. The historic Greenwich Terrace, a community of 16 residences, designed by architect T Patterson Ross, is a significant early example of co-operative residential living with exquisite Edwardian detailing. Treasured to this day for its prominent location, serene privacy & stunning views from Alcatraz Island, Coit Tower, to the Financial District & Bay Bridge, the lush garden setting, on a quiet cul-de-sac, is just steps from tennis, dining, night life, shops, a literal feast of San Francisco street life & culture. The generous living room with fireplace + library are flooded with glorious light, walk-out terrace & elegant formal dining room are projected into dramatic views. The professionally equipped, custom kitchen, a serious culinary environment, is the heart of this well-designed home. 3 bedrooms, 2 luxe baths, a spacious primary suite, impressive closets, storage & 1 car pkg, anchor the warm livability of this exquisite home. Stroll, tennis, shop & dine, the world-class treasures of San Francisco are at your feet
